data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to download files using native platform capabilities.
data.what_it_does: It downloads files using DownloadManager on Android, URLSession on iOS, and BITS on Windows. It also provides tracking of download progress and status updates.
use_when: You need to download files directly to the device's storage (Downloads or App Documents folder).
You want to leverage native background download capabilities across Android, iOS, and Windows.
avoid_when: You need complex HTTP client configuration for REST API calls rather than just downloading files.
strengths: Uses native platform capabilities (DownloadManager, URLSession, BITS) for reliable downloads.
Provides progress and status tracking streams.
weaknesses: Requires specific platform configurations and SDK requirements for older Android versions or iOS file sharing.
ID types returned can vary between platforms (integers vs GUID strings).
data.setup_notes: Requires setting compileSdk 36 on Android, permission handling for Android 9 or below, and optional Info.plist keys for iOS Files app sharing.
